description: This file defines an interface 'NodeInterface' for nested set nodes within an ORM, outlining methods for tree operations such as retrieving children, managing parent-child relationships, and node status checks.

classes.name: NodeInterface
classes.description: An interface defining operations for nodes in a nested set hierarchy, including methods for accessing children, parent, and node properties, as well as managing node relationships.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Returns true if the node has children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves the children of the node up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Returns true if the node has a parent.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node if it exists; null otherwise.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level (depth) of the node within the tree.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of the specified parent node.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Returns true if the node is a leaf (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Returns true if the node is a root (has no parent).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its descendants from the hierarchy.
